title.zh: 美国监管机构再次调查Polymarket是否违反2022年达成的和解协议
title.en: 美国监管机构再次调查Polymarket是否违反2022年达成的和解协议

current_state.zh: The CFTC is investigating whether Polymarket violated its 2022 settlement by failing to adequately prevent U.S. users from accessing its offshore platform, as part of a broader review of geolocation controls, advertising, and U.S. customer onboarding.
current_state.en: The CFTC is investigating whether Polymarket violated its 2022 settlement by failing to adequately prevent U.S. users from accessing its offshore platform, as part of a broader review of geolocation controls, advertising, and U.S. customer onboarding.
